views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates noted Lululemon was down about 55% for the year while the index was up 14%, underscoring how individual large caps diverged sharply from headline market gains.

episode.title: Firmus IPO falls apart & the invisible crash behind Wall Street’s record highs

views.text: In January 2026, Equity Mates highlighted Lululemon’s share price falling 46% over 12 months and said it was knocked out of the NASDAQ 100, adding that many comparable apparel names were trading around 15 times P/E.

In August 2022, Equity Mates explained that Lululemon’s higher share price did not mean a larger company, with Nike much bigger by sales, clarifying that price per share reflects how the equity is sliced, not total value.
